title: Material class
description: One class of the cross-domain material layer (data/materials/<class>.json). Each material is one real thing: a fruit, a fibre, a cloth, a metal, a clay body, a glaze. A material with a sense is also an entry of a domain vocabulary, with the same id. The domain vocabulary keeps its own fields; this layer adds the class, the form, the edges between materials, the properties and the sources.

families.description: The families of the class. Each material names one.

class.description: The class by origin. plant: from a plant or an alga. animal: from an animal. fungus: a mushroom, a yeast or a mould, or a food that a fungus makes. mineral: a stone, a clay, a sand, a pigment or a salt, as it is dug. metal: an element or an alloy. ceramic-glass: a fired clay body, a glaze, a glass or an enamel. polymer: a synthetic or a regenerated long-chain material. composite: a mix of two or more classes (concrete, plaster, paint, laminate).

form.description: The state in which the material is used. raw: as it comes from the source. part: a made part. body: a clay body. coating: a layer on another material. surface: the state of a surface with no added layer (bare clay, burnished). food: a cooking ingredient.

sense.description: A domain vocabulary list that has an entry with the id of the material.

senses.description: The vocabulary lists that use this id. Empty for a material that only this layer has (a parent such as clay or iron).

part_of.description: The whole of which this material is a part: banana-leaf part_of banana-plant.

made_from.description: The raw materials of a product: linen-cloth made_from flax.

aliases.description: Lower-case free-text names. The build matches them to the material text of architecture, interior and painting styles.

parts.description: The named parts of the real object (peel, flesh, stalk).

colour.description: The natural colour of the material.

fire_c.description: The firing range in °C, for a clay body or a glaze.

warmth.description: The felt warmth to the hand: 0 cold metal, 1 wool.

photo.description: The subject words for the studio photo, when the name alone is not clear to an image model.
